description: This file defines the OAuthTokensController class that manages deletion actions for OAuth token records within the SuiteCRM framework. It handles deletion requests, permission checks, and post-deletion redirection.

classes.name: OAuthTokensController
classes.description: Controller class managing OAuth token record deletions within SuiteCRM, extending the base SugarController.

methods.name: action_delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of OAuth token records, including permission checks and record marking.

methods.name: post_delete
methods.description: Performs post-deletion actions, such as redirecting to a return URL if provided.
